title: THE NEW LEAN CERTIFICATES -- the jump, the share, the lift
question: Certify the three new closed forms from the G159/G186 wave, algebra-only in the G03G/G083/G090 spine convention (standalone file, no imports, every sqrt closed by the sqrt_pair sign-resolution technique, rM2 = G*Mb/a0 kept symbolic where sqrt appears): (1) jump_cube -- the G159 amplitude A_b = (sigma_ph/sigma_d)^3 = exp(dS/k_B) as an ENTROPY statement (ln A_b = 3 ln(sigma_ph/sigma_d), the 3 the phase-space dimension count), NOT the naive isothermal reading (which gives rho_ph/rho_d = (sigma_d/sigma_ph)^2 only); (2) share_identity -- the phantom share of the missing mass = (r/r_M)/(f-1), one field_simp line; (3) deep_limit_sq -- the deep RAR g^2 = a0 g_N restated (G031 deep_rar already certified) plus the NEW sqrt reading g = sqrt(a0 g_N), stated carefully; (4) the honest inventory: which of the wave's closed forms are Lean-CERTIFIED vs algebra-only-on-record.

theorems.name: isothermal_density_ratio
theorems.statement: rph/rd = (sd/sph)^2 from rph*sph^2 = rd*sd^2 (shared-C isothermal identity at equal r) -- the honest 2D MECHANICAL ratio: exponent 2, ratio INVERTED
theorems.physics: the shared-well mechanics (rho*sigma^2 = C/(4 pi G r^2)) does NOT give (sph/sd)^3; it gives the inverted square -- certified exactly so, the correction the task demanded

theorems.name: entropy_jump_log
theorems.statement: ln A_b = 3 ln(sph/sd) with A_b := exp(3 ln(sph/sd)) -- the G159 entropy jump exactly as stated (one Real.log_exp)
theorems.physics: the 3 is the phase-space dimension count: dS/k_B = 3 ln(sigma_ph/sigma_d)

theorems.name: entropy_jump_cube
theorems.statement: log((sph/sd)^3) = 3 log(sph/sd) -- the same 3 at the power level (Real.log_pow, unconditional)
theorems.physics: the cube falls out of the logarithm of the 3D phase-space occupancy ratio

theorems.name: entropy_jump_additivity
theorems.statement: exp(3 ln(sph/sd)) = (sph/sd)^3 -- the amplitude as exp(dS/k_B), positivity-closed via Real.exp_log
theorems.physics: A_b = exp(dS/k_B) with dS = 3 ln(sigma_ph/sigma_d): the G159 branch-B closed form, entropy-carried

theorems.name: jump_cube
theorems.statement: A_b := exp(3 ln(sph/sd)) = (sph/sd)^3 -- the G159 amplitude A_b = (sigma_ph/sigma_d)^3, stated WITHOUT overclaim (an entropy consequence, not an isothermal-mechanics one)
theorems.physics: the certified reading of G159's (sigma_ph/sigma_d)^3; the dressed numbers (0.125-0.5, geomean 0.273) and their comparison with G098/G185 are committed-lane physics, NOT certified here

theorems.name: share_identity
theorems.statement: (Mb*(r/rM))/(f*Mb - Mb) = (r/rM)/(f-1) -- the phantom share of the missing mass, one field_simp line, rM symbolic (no sqrt)
theorems.physics: with M_ph = M_b r/r_M (linear law) and M_dyn = f M_b: share = M_ph/(M_dyn - M_b); the M_b cancels, leaving (r/r_M)/(f-1)

theorems.name: share_identity_deep
theorems.statement: the same share with r_M := sqrt(G*Mb/a0) (rM2 = G*Mb/a0 symbolic under the single sqrt, closed by Real.sqrt_pos)
theorems.physics: the deep instantiation of the pie law (G186/G197/G188 use the share (r/r_M)/(f-1) with r_M = sqrt(G M_b/a0))

theorems.name: deep_limit_sq
theorems.statement: g^2 = a0*g_N AND g = sqrt(a0*g_N) with g := S/r, S := sqrt(G*Mb*a0), g_N := G*Mb/r^2 -- the deep RAR restated (G031 deep_rar) plus the NEW sqrt reading
theorems.physics: the deep-limit acceleration is the GEOMETRIC MEAN sqrt(a0*g_N); stated carefully: the same statement in geometric-mean form, not an independent law -- valid because g >= 0 (sq_eq + nonnegativity, the sqrt_pair sign-resolution technique)
